entries.methodology: Approximate population = density × intersected area. Independent rectangular density cells are clipped to the footprint in spherical cylindrical equal-area coordinates (longitude, sin latitude; radius 6,371.0088 km). Edges are straight in that calculation plane; this is a numerical fixture model, not a historical measurement. Holes are subtracted and disjoint territory parts are added. Values are subtotals for covered areas; unobserved areas are not extrapolated. The fixed reference retains the authored 950 CE footprint while using the selected epoch’s density.
notes: Precomputed from the complete display geometry before tiling.
Invented fixture data; covered-area subtotals, not historical measurements.
